notes.title: Version 1.04 Update
notes.content:
- Save System - Added the ability to overwrite existing saves.
- Save System - Limited the maximum amount of possible player saves to 40, to preserve system stability. This should also prevent new cases of the error that caused some players to be unable to load their saves.
- Servants - Added several more servant interactions to various incidents throughout the game, to improve their usefulness.
- Story - Enhanced several sections in the epilogue related to Armand and his... plans.
- General - In the case of certain errors, the game will give you the ability to email your save data to customer support so we can help you more directly.
- General - Typos and minor animation fixes.

To go into the saves issue a little bit more: When we first designed the save system, we didn't put a limit on the amount of saves that players could have. However, it appears that we [b]seriously underestimated[/b] the amount of separate save files some players would have. Once players started getting into the area of 300+ save files, issues started appearing with our game's ability to properly create and maintain the integrity of the file. This sometimes manifested as players being unable to load their saves at all, as the game was trying to load corrupted data. To that end, we've limited the amount of separate saves a player can have at any one time to 40 (not including the autosave), which is still a lot of files.

Any players who have more than 40 saves will be prompted to delete some of their saves before they can make any new save files. We're really sorry about any inconvenience this might cause, but it's turned out to be necessary to prevent file corruption, and potential loss of game progress (which is something we clearly have to place a high priority on preventing). 

Thanks again for your patience and support!

- Luther

notes.title: The Artist Statement
notes.content:
Joy Manufacturing Co. is a small team mainly based out of San Francisco (though we're distributed across the world, at this point). We focus on crafting games that tell interesting stories which aren’t being told elsewhere in the world of games. The core of our studio is composed of veterans of the mobile and social game industry who grew dissatisfied with its metrics driven approach to all elements of production. We wanted to make something that appealed strongly to specific audiences, rather than something that appealed broadly but shallowly to everyone. We also all happened to be in the same D&D group, and have honestly spent more time screaming at each other over that game than we have while working on our own game.

'Ambition: A Minuet in Power' is a game about soft power, dangerous romance, and intrigue in a country that is on the verge of both collapse, and bloody revolution. We never really intended to make a topical game, but it's admittedly starting to feel like we managed to do so by accident.

In Ambition, you are not a warrior, spy, or king, but a woman who is seeking a better life than the one her humble hometown could provide. It's a story that is fun, dark, and intriguing. It's also a story that I think many, in these perilous times of ours, might find invigorating. Just because one is not powerful, doesn't mean that they are powerless. Power, much like love, has many different forms.

Ambition is our studio's first title, and its production has honestly been a result of both continuous hard work, and absolutely miraculous moments. After our successful Kickstarter Campaign we had the honor of being nominated for the 'Best Style' category in the 2019 Bit Awards, as well as presenting as part of the Indie Megabooth at PAX East 2020. In fact, at PAX East 2020, we were nominated as one of the 'Hidden Gems of PAX East' at one of the panels, as well as being one of Ars Technica's 'Top Indie Games of PAX East 2020'. It's been equal parts exciting, and positively terrifying.

Thank you for taking the time to read this, and please enjoy our demo!

- Luther Patenge
Game Designer and Writer
Joy Manufacturing Co. LLC

notes.title: Ambition: A Minuet in Power - Discord Developer Chat - June 17th, 2020
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/wdqGmTf][h1]Join our Discord Channel Here![/h1][/url]
[i]Note: You may have to wait to be assigned a role in the chat.[/i]

Have you played our demo and would like to know more? Join Luther, our Game Designer and Writer, on our Discord channel to ask your questions, live!

'Ambition: A Minuet in Power' is a rogue-lite visual novel where you play as an unmarried woman of fashion in 18th Century Paris looking to acquire love, wealth, and power by any means necessary! Just make you don't get beheaded... or assassinated... or driven to bankruptcy. It was a wild time to be alive.

Additionally, we're live-streaming our demo on Twitch 5:00pm - 6:00pm Pacific Time, Tuesday June 16th for the Steam Games Festival
